info.title: Lightinator HTTP API
info.description: HTTP API inferred from app/webserver.cpp and esp_rgb_webapp2/src/services/api.js. app-config.cfgdb and app-data.cfgdb remain the authoritative schemas for separate persistent ConfigDB databases; OpenAPI references generated JSON Schema projections because general OpenAPI tooling does not recognize the .cfgdb media type.

get.description: Returns the complete board/template catalog as gzip-compressed JSON. The HTTP client should transparently decode Content-Encoding.

get.summary: Get legacy or version 2 controller information

parameters.name: sparse
parameters.description: Omit volatile runtime and debug sections when true.

get.summary: Get the selected or default light's active color representation

post.summary: Execute one or more color commands

get.summary: Get Wi-Fi scan state and visible networks

get.description: Not supported by the Host build.

post.description: Not supported by the Host build.

get.summary: Get web application OTA status and trigger a check when idle

post.summary: Force a web application update check

basicAuth.description: Enabled only when security.api_secured is true.

LightSelector.name: light
LightSelector.description: Persistent configured light index. Omission selects the unique is_default light. If JSON also supplies light, the values must match.

BadRequest.description: Malformed input, invalid command, unsupported method, OTA conflict, or unsupported platform

Busy.description: Insufficient free heap or OTA load shedding

gamma.description: System output gamma for correction calculation (e.g. 2.2)

ct.description: Parabolic coefficients for Color Temperature curve

capability.description: Bit mask: input=1, output=2, pwm=4, strapping=8, pull_up=16, pull_down=32, reserved=64.

gamma.description: System output gamma for correction calculation (e.g. 2.2)

ct.description: Parabolic coefficients for Color Temperature curve

type.description: RGBWWCW, RGBWW, RGBCW, RGB, WWCW, WW, CW or SINGLE, matching RGBWWLed::LightType.

pins.description: Physical GPIO numbers in type order: RGBWWCW=[R,G,B,WW,CW], RGBWW=[R,G,B,WW], RGBCW=[R,G,B,CW], RGB=[R,G,B], WWCW=[WW,CW], WW=[WW], CW=[CW], SINGLE=[single output].
Board pin IDs in the channel order defined by type; frontend resolves IDs to GPIO numbers before activation.

clear_config_pin.description: Physical GPIO used for configuration clear when enabled.

Wire.title: Lightinator transient wire API
Wire.description: Transient HTTP, JSON-RPC and event workspaces inferred from firmware and frontend implementations.

absoluteOrRelativeValue.description: Canonical generated value. Current firmware also accepts legacy relative-value strings, which are intentionally outside the generated contract because ConfigDB does not support scalar unions.
